freshShadowDiagnostic.purpose: One targeted matched pair tests the source-audit finding that a cached shadow can remain stale when the wall-clock dirty window expires between slow software-rendered frames. This diagnostic is separate from the original strict failed capture.
protocol: Use the original baseline and candidate builds, identical 384×288 actual drawing buffer, DPR 1, q=lo, graphics=1, quality lock, noon lighting, H1 top view and geographic tree zones.
Wait for the existing camera/terrain settling condition.
Call the existing V3D.setShadowUpdate(true) API; wait at least two completed frames.
Capture and compare; then restore V3D.setShadowUpdate(false). No input interactions are attempted.
